ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; Class meetings will be held at River Woods Elementary School in Naperville, IL from 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM on Tuesday through Friday (July 5 to July 8), Monday through Friday (July 11 to July 15), and Monday, August 1. Please note the August 1st meeting will be held at the Multi-University Center in Oak Brook, IL. Students should bring their lunch to all class meetings.
